API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIAppProtection Control ManagementGets all custom controls and sorts by control number for the specified customer.
Gets all custom controls and sorts by control number for the specified customer.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/inspectionControls/custom

Gets all custom controls and sorts by control number for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Example: 1
pagesize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Example: 20
sortdir
string

Possible values: [ASC, DESC]

Specifies the sorting order (ascending/descending) for the search results.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
503

OK

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
currentCount
int64

The total count of resources per the search feature.

list
InspectionCustomControl[]
totalCount
int64

The total number of pages per the pagination attribute.

totalPages
int32

The total list of AppProtection custom controls.
